title: Bird counts from 381 five-minute point counts at 13 rainforest fragment, plantation and control sites, Anamalai hills, Western Ghats, India, 2001-2002 (coordinates coarsened)
creator: Raman, T. R. Shankar
citation: Raman, T. R. S. (2020). Data from: Effects of habitat structure and adjacent habitats on birds in tropical rainforest fragments and shaded plantations in the Western Ghats, India [Dataset]. Dryad. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.4mw6m907q
samplingProtocol: Five-minute stationary bird point counts (25-30 per site) recording every bird seen or heard with its radial distance band (0-50 m) and cue; y = individuals detected of the species in the count (the source's 'Number', summed over its records).
closureNote: the 25-30 point counts of a site, made on 2-4 mornings between December 2001 and April 2002, are its replicates; they are sequential counts within the site (the deposit gives no point locations and does not say whether a point was revisited), so occasion = count number within the site, in the source's order.
covariateNote: unit_stratum (rainforest / plantation), unit_stratum_detail (control, fragment, coffee, cardamom), unit_connectivity (canopy connectivity with adjacent habitat, high / low, as in Raman 2006). obs_time_hhmm: time of the count's first record (hhmm, morning).
abstract: Bird point counts in a Western Ghats landscape of rainforest fragments and shade plantations (Valparai plateau and Indira Gandhi Wildlife Sanctuary, Anamalai hills): 13 sites (one primary rainforest control, six fragments of high or low canopy connectivity, five coffee and one cardamom plantation), 25-30 five-minute counts each, December 2001 to April 2002; 107 taxa. One row per count x taxon, y = individuals detected. Site coordinates are coarsened to 0.1 degree because Buceros bicornis (IUCN VU) and Ocyceros griseus (IUCN VU) are in the table; raman_2006_anamalai_birds_exact_count has the other taxa at the published coordinates.
geographicCoverage: Valparai plateau and Indira Gandhi Wildlife Sanctuary, Anamalai hills, Western Ghats, Tamil Nadu, India (site coordinates coarsened to 0.1 degree)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: site coordinates (6 decimals in the source) replaced by 0.1 degree cell centres (coarsen_coords) because Buceros bicornis (IUCN VU) and Ocyceros griseus (IUCN VU) occur in the table; site names not shipped (E7.4); the unit is the source's site letter

notShipped.total_estimated: Total: individuals estimated with supplementary flock-size data, not the count made (Total > Number in 928 records, < Number in 67, 66 of them heard birds)
notShipped.distance_cues: per-record radial distance band and cue (heard / seen / flying); a distance-sampling table could be built from them
notShipped.summaries: 05_Detections, 06_Abundance (sums of these records, rebuilt and asserted) and 07_Appendix (rates per 25 counts and deviations)
notShipped.vegetation: 08-11 vegetation plots (PCQ, habitat structure, Siva Coffee plots and trees), keyed to vegetation points, not to the bird counts
notShipped.unit_site_name: site names (E7.4: a coarsened table names no place); in raman_2006_anamalai_birds_exact_count

notes: Taxa are the eBird India 2018 names; four are slash pairs for species split after 2006 and UNID is an unidentified bird (class Aves). raman_2006_anamalai_birds_exact_count has the 105 taxa other than the two hornbills at the published coordinates.
